question: Should the repository security/admin owner authorize Axios 1.18.1 and its regenerated dependency graph on this exact PR head, or should those files be split into a separate maintainer-owned security update?
rationale: The dependency guard expressly reserves external dependency-graph changes for an exact-head repository security/admin decision; automated review cannot supply that authorization.

options.title: Split the dependency update
options.body: Restore the Axios override, lockfile, and plugin shrinkwrap changes here, then land the security update through the repository's generated dependency workflow.

options.title: Authorize this exact head
options.body: A repository admin or security owner can explicitly approve the reviewed Axios 1.18.1 graph on the current head if keeping both changes together is intentional.
